name: Area-generic outlet-headroom / drainage-coping indicator over a declared horizon, with refusal

statement.latest: \text{For a declared drainage unit } U \text{ (village, district, province, or sub-basin) with tuple } \langle A_U, O_U, P_U, c_U\rangle \text{ and horizon } H \text{ hours, all quantities on } \mathbb{Q}:\quad R_H(U) := \sum_{o \in O_U} \max(0,\, Q_{cap,o} - Q_{o,now})\cdot H\cdot 3600 \quad D_H(U) := \sum_{t=1}^{H} \Big(\sum_{p \in P_U^{run}} P_{run,p}\Big)\cdot 3600\cdot g_U(t) \quad F_H(U) := c_U\cdot A_U \cdot \sum_{t=1}^{H} rain_t + \sum_{t=1}^{H} Q_{in,up}(t)\cdot 3600 \quad \boxed{S_H(U) := \dfrac{F_H(U)}{\min(D_H(U), R_H(U))}} \text{ with declared tiers OK} (<0.5), \text{TIGHT} (0.5\text{-}1), \text{CRITICAL} (>1); \quad \text{binding}(U) := \arg\min(R_H(U), D_H(U)) \in \{\text{OUTLET}, \text{PUMP}\}, \text{ and per outlet } o: \text{binding}(o) := [R_o = \min_{o'\in O_U} R_{o'}]; \quad \boxed{\text{REFUSED (reason} \in \{\text{UNIT\_NOT\_DECLARED, MISSING\_INPUT, STALE\_INPUT, UNDECLARED\_AREA, UNDECLARED\_EDGE, ZERO\_CAPACITY\_NONZERO\_INFLOW}\}\text{)}} \text{ when the tuple is incomplete, any required input is missing/stale/undeclared, or } \min(D_H,R_H)=0 \text{ while } F_H>0. \quad \text{Urgency: } T_{act}(U):=\min\{t\in\{1,\dots,H\}: F_t(U)\ge\min(D_t(U),R_t(U))\} \text{ (}">H"\text{ if none, reusing PROP-FLOOD-02); combined tier ladder } L_0..L_5,L_R \text{ over } (S_H,T_{act}) \text{, OPEN-for-founder-tuning thresholds, LR (REFUSED) always dominant. Unit } U \text{ MAY be resolved from any } (\text{lat},\text{lon})\in\text{Thailand} \text{ via the graph (basin polygon / nearest reach / pump assets / gauges), each resolved input tagged VERIFIED/RELAYED/INSTINCT, REFUSED (UNIT\_POLYGON\_MISSING, OUTLET\_CAPACITY\_UNKNOWN, NO\_GAUGE\_IN\_UNIT) rather than degraded when unresolved; NO\_PUMPS\_IN\_UNIT is not an error.
statement.note_ascii: For a declared drainage unit U (village, district, province, or sub-basin) with tuple <A_U, O_U, P_U, c_U> and horizon H hours, all on Q: R_H(U) := sum over outlets o in O_U of max(0, Q_cap,o - Q_o,now) * H*3600 (m^3), the total river/outlet headroom over the horizon, summed across every declared downstream receiving reach/sea/reservoir for U (Bangkok has one outlet, Chao Phraya via pumps+Gulf; a village may have one canal/basin outlet; Ayutthaya has one river outlet with no pumps). D_H(U) := sum over hours t=1..H of (sum of running-pump capacities P_run,p for p in P_U) * 3600 * g_U(t) (m^3), the drainage volume clearable by pumps actually running, where g_U(t) in (0,1] is a gravity/pump derating factor: g_U(t)=1 when the outlet's river/tide level is below a declared gravity-threshold, else a declared derating factor (OPEN default=1 with a flag); for a non-tidal outlet g_U(t)=1 by declaration unless the unit separately declares a derating condition. When P_U is empty (no pumps declared for U, e.g. a river-only mainstem town), D_H(U) := 0 by definition, not REFUSED. F_H(U) := c_U * A_U * sum_t rain_forecast(t) (m^3, mm converted to m) + sum_t Q_in,up(t)*3600 (m^3), forecast inflow: the rainfall-runoff term (c_U runoff coefficient DECLARED or, if undeclared, reported as a bound pair [c=0.5, c=1], never a single silent point; A_U catchment area DECLARED with a tag; rain from the nearest official gauges + multi-model ensemble, reported as two readouts, median and max) PLUS an upstream-inflow term Q_in,up(t), the declared flow arriving from upstream graph edges into U (zero when U declares no upstream edge, e.g. Bangkok/Sammakorn; the binding term for a mainstem town like Ayutthaya, which has no rainfall-runoff catchment of consequence relative to river inflow). The indicator S_H(U) := F_H(U) / min(D_H(U), R_H(U)), a finite Q-valued ratio, reported with a declared tier convention (a convention, not a derived boundary): OK if S_H<0.5, TIGHT if 0.5<=S_H<=1, CRITICAL if S_H>1. A separate boolean readout reports which term is binding at unit level, binding(U) in {OUTLET, PUMP} := whichever of R_H(U), D_H(U) is the smaller (the argmin), and per outlet o a second boolean binding(o) := true iff R_o (that outlet's own headroom alone) equals the minimum R_o' across all of U's outlets (identifies which specific outlet is the unit's constraint when U has more than one). REFUSED (reason in {UNIT_NOT_DECLARED, MISSING_INPUT, STALE_INPUT, UNDECLARED_AREA, UNDECLARED_EDGE, ZERO_CAPACITY_NONZERO_INFLOW}) whenever the declared tuple <A_U, O_U, P_U, c_U> is incomplete (UNIT_NOT_DECLARED), any required reading/declaration is absent (MISSING_INPUT) or a time-varying one is stale (STALE_INPUT), the catchment area is undeclared (UNDECLARED_AREA), an inflow arrives over an undeclared upstream edge (UNDECLARED_EDGE), or min(D_H,R_H)=0 while F_H>0 (ZERO_CAPACITY_NONZERO_INFLOW, a genuinely non-evaluable case reported as a refusal rather than as an unbounded/CRITICAL numeric value, per the workspace's zero-infinity non-readout guard). When min(D_H,R_H)=0 and F_H=0 as well, S_H(U):=0 (OK) is a valid, non-refused readout: no capacity is declared and none is needed. Urgency companion T_act(U) := the smallest hour t<=H at which cumulative F_t(U) reaches min(D_t,R_t) (partial sums through t), directly reusing PROP-FLOOD-02's time-to-threshold construction with a time-varying threshold; reported as the string ">H" when no crossing occurs within the horizon (a determinate, non-refused outcome). The severity band on S_H(U) and the urgency band on T_act(U) are combined into a single declared >=5-level tier ladder L0 (normal) .. L4 (act now) plus L5 (system already exhausted/overtopped, checked before the ratio) and LR (REFUSED, dominant over every numeric band) -- thresholds 0.3/0.6/0.9/1.2 on S_H and 6h/24h/48h on T_act are proposed here and explicitly marked OPEN-for-founder-tuning, not derived. U itself may be RESOLVED from any (lat,lon) in Thailand by walking the water/basin/pump/gauge graph rather than hand-declared: A_U from a basin polygon (VERIFIED) or, absent one, a declared radius-r circle (INSTINCT, r stated) -- else REFUSED UNIT_POLYGON_MISSING; O_U from the nearest reach via HydroRIVERS edges (RELAYED), Q_cap,o from the capacity ledger or else REFUSED OUTLET_CAPACITY_UNKNOWN for that outlet; P_U from pump_station assets inside A_U, empty being the valid NO_PUMPS_IN_UNIT case (D_H:=0, not an error); rain from gauges inside A_U or nearest-k, else REFUSED NO_GAUGE_IN_UNIT; every resolved input carries its VERIFIED/RELAYED/INSTINCT tag, and the whole tier readout is REFUSED, never silently degraded, when a required resolved input has none of these tags.

unit_resolution.input: any (lat, lon) in Thailand -- the drainage unit U is RESOLVED from the graph, never hand-declared, per founder instruction 2026-09-27 ("ทำให้ใช้ได้ทุกละติจูด ลองจิจูดในไทย"); this is the resolver PROP-FLOOD-06 requires before any of R_H/D_H/F_H can be evaluated, and it is itself a total function with its own refusal codes, checked before the ledger arithmetic above
unit_resolution.A_U_resolution: A_U := the sub-basin/basin polygon containing (lat,lon), VERIFIED against a declared basin-polygon layer if one exists in the graph; if only the 22 basin nodes exist WITHOUT polygons, REFUSED (UNIT_POLYGON_MISSING) unless a declared fallback radius-r circle around the point is explicitly opted into, tagged INSTINCT with r stated in the report -- the fallback is never silently substituted
unit_resolution.O_U_resolution: O_U := the downstream reach/canal node(s) reached by walking declared WATER edges from the nearest reach/canal node to (lat,lon) (edges sourced from HydroRIVERS, tagged RELAYED); for each resolved outlet o, Q_cap,o is read from the capacity ledger (e.g. C.29/C.13-adjacent constants) if present, else the outlet is retained in O_U but its headroom term is REFUSED (OUTLET_CAPACITY_UNKNOWN) rather than silently defaulted
unit_resolution.P_U_resolution: P_U := every pump_station asset whose declared location falls within the resolved A_U, with running/not-running state from the latest available readout; P_U resolving to empty is NOT an error -- it is the declared NO_PUMPS_IN_UNIT case and D_H(U):=0 by definition, identical to the Ayutthaya instantiation
unit_resolution.rain_resolution: rain_t at the point is read from official gauges within the resolved A_U (or, if none fall inside A_U, the nearest k gauges outside it, tagged with that fallback) plus the ensemble ensemble forecast evaluated at (lat,lon); no gauge within A_U and no declared nearest-k fallback is REFUSED (NO_GAUGE_IN_UNIT)
unit_resolution.upstream_inflow_resolution: Q_in,up(t) := the reading at the graph edge/gauge entering the resolved A_U from upstream, if the graph declares one; absent declaration, the term is 0 by the same UNDECLARED_EDGE discipline already stated above (never silently non-zero, never silently REFUSED-for-the-whole-unit on this term alone unless the unit's own tuple requires it)
unit_resolution.evidence_tagging: every resolved input is reported with its evidence tag (VERIFIED for a directly gauged/declared reading, RELAYED for a graph-sourced constant such as HydroRIVERS edges or a relayed capacity figure, INSTINCT for a fallback such as the radius-r circle or an untagged derating factor) alongside the numeric value -- the tier readout (see readout_classes.tier_ladder) is REFUSED, never silently degraded to a lower-confidence numeric answer, whenever a required resolved input carries none of these three tags (i.e. is simply missing).

definitions.U: a declared drainage unit: a village, district, province, or sub-basin -- the object is area-generic, not Bangkok-specific; U is defined by its own declared tuple, never inferred from geography
definitions.tuple<A_U,O_U,P_U,c_U>: the required declaration for U: A_U (catchment area, m^2), O_U (outlet set, non-empty for a REFUSED-free evaluation of R_H), P_U (pump set, may be declared empty), c_U (runoff coefficient or bound pair) -- an incomplete tuple is REFUSED UNIT_NOT_DECLARED before any other input is even checked
definitions.O_U: the outlet set for U: one or more downstream receiving reaches/sea/reservoirs, each a declared outlet o with its own Q_cap,o and Q_o,now -- e.g. Bangkok east zone's outlet is Chao Phraya via pumps + the Gulf; Sammakorn village's outlet is Khlong Ban Ma / the retention basin; Ayutthaya's outlet is the Chao Phraya mainstem itself, no pumps
definitions.Q_cap,o: declared conveyance/discharge capacity of outlet o (m^3/s) -- a static declaration with a tag (e.g. 3,000-3,100 m^3/s RELAYED for the Chao Phraya reach at Bangkok, cited from C.29/C.13-adjacent capacity notes); subject only to MISSING_INPUT, never STALE_INPUT
definitions.Q_o,now: the latest gauged flow/level reading at outlet o (m^3/s), e.g. the C.29/C.13 station reading -- time-varying, subject to STALE_INPUT/MISSING_INPUT
definitions.R_H(U): outlet headroom over horizon H: summed across every declared outlet in O_U, max(0, Q_cap,o - Q_o,now)*H*3600 (m^3) -- the volume the river/outlet system could still convey over H hours at its current declared capacity margin, before any pump or rainfall term
definitions.P_U: the pump set for U, each p with a running capacity P_run,p (m^3/s) -- e.g. Sammakorn's ST./SPS pumps; declared empty for a unit with no pumping infrastructure (Ayutthaya mainstem town), in which case D_H(U):=0 by definition, not refused
definitions.g_U(t): gravity/pump derating factor in (0,1] at hour t: 1 when the outlet's river/tide level is below a declared gravity-threshold (drainage runs freely or pumps are unconstrained), else a declared derating factor -- OPEN default=1 with an explicit flag when U has not declared one; the tide term applies ONLY where U's outlet is tidal (Bangkok); a non-tidal outlet (Sammakorn's canal, Ayutthaya's river) declares g_U(t)=1 for all t unless it separately declares a different condition
definitions.D_H(U): drainage volume clearable over H hours: sum over hours of (sum of running pump capacities in P_U) * 3600 * g_U(t) -- zero when P_U is empty
definitions.c_U: runoff coefficient for U, in Q intersect [0,1] -- DECLARED with a source, or, if undeclared, reported as the bound pair [0.5, 1], never a single silent point value (OPEN/INSTINCT until measured for the specific catchment)
definitions.rain_t: forecast rainfall at hour t (mm, converted to m) for U's declared bounding box, from the nearest official gauges plus a multi-model ensemble -- reported as two parallel readouts, the ensemble median and the ensemble max, never collapsed to one number
definitions.Q_in,up(t): declared upstream inflow arriving into U over a declared upstream graph edge (m^3/s) at hour t -- zero when U declares no upstream edge (Bangkok, Sammakorn); the dominant/only inflow term for a mainstem town like Ayutthaya, where the rainfall-runoff term is comparatively negligible; an inflow arriving over an UNdeclared edge is REFUSED UNDECLARED_EDGE, never folded in as zero
definitions.F_H(U): forecast inflow volume over H hours: c_U*A_U*sum(rain_t) + sum(Q_in,up(t)*3600) -- the rainfall-runoff term and the upstream-mainstem term are both present in the general form; either collapses to 0 when U declares no catchment (A_U=0, not applicable) or no upstream edge respectively
definitions.S_H(U): the coping indicator, F_H(U) / min(D_H(U), R_H(U)) -- a finite Q-valued ratio; undefined only in the degenerate case min(D_H,R_H)=0 and F_H>0, which is REFUSED rather than reported as an unbounded number
definitions.OK/TIGHT/CRITICAL: a declared tier convention over S_H(U): OK for S_H<0.5, TIGHT for 0.5<=S_H<=1, CRITICAL for S_H>1 -- these boundaries are a convention this proposal declares, not a derived physical threshold; falsifiable per-unit by observed outcomes (see honest_caveats)
definitions.binding(U): boolean/enum readout, OUTLET if R_H(U) <= D_H(U) else PUMP -- reports which term is the unit-level constraint on min(D_H,R_H); when P_U is empty, binding(U):=OUTLET always (D_H=0 can only bind or tie)
definitions.binding(o): per-outlet boolean readout for each o in O_U: true iff R_o = max(0,Q_cap,o-Q_o,now)*H*3600 is the minimum among all outlets' own headroom terms -- identifies which specific outlet is the constraining one when |O_U|>1; vacuously true for the single outlet when |O_U|=1
definitions.T_act(U): time-to-exhaustion readout, ticks/hours: T_act := min{ t in {1,...,H} : F_t(U) >= min(D_t(U), R_t(U)) } where F_t, D_t, R_t are the same three quantities accumulated only through hour t (partial sums, not the full-H totals) -- the smallest horizon at which cumulative forecast inflow would consume the unit's clearable volume. Directly reuses PROP-FLOOD-02's time-to-threshold construction (T_k := (theta-h(t))*k/Delta_k(t), REFUSED-as-non-value discipline) with theta:=min(D_t,R_t) as a time-varying threshold and h(t):=F_t(U) as the rising series; if the crossing does not occur within the declared horizon H, T_act is reported as the declared string ">H" (a determinate 'not within this horizon', not a numeric extrapolation past H and not REFUSED, since 'not yet reached by hour H' is itself a valid, licensed outcome of the search over t in {1,...,H}).

readout_classes.tier_ladder: REPLACES a bare 3-band S_H convention with a declared >=5-level ladder combining S_H(U) (severity) and T_act(U) (urgency), per founder instruction 2026-09-27 that a resident needs to know 'act now vs. there is still time', not severity alone. Bands are a declared convention, OPEN-for-founder-tuning (marked so explicitly), evaluated as: whichever of the S_H-band or T_act-band is HIGHER (later/more urgent in the ladder below) governs the reported level; both sub-readouts are always shown alongside the governing level, never only the combined level. Ladder (S_H band / T_act band -> level): S_H<0.3 and T_act>H -> L0 ('ปกติ'); 0.3<=S_H<0.6 or T_act>48h -> L1 ('เฝ้าดู'); 0.6<=S_H<0.9 or 24h<T_act<=48h -> L2 ('เตรียมตัวได้ ยังมีเวลา'); 0.9<=S_H<1.2 or 6h<T_act<=24h -> L3 ('ทำตอนนี้ภายในวันนี้'); S_H>=1.2 or T_act<=6h -> L4 ('เร่งด่วนเดี๋ยวนี้'); L5 ('เกินระบบแล้ว') := a separate, higher-precedence declared condition, not a band on S_H/T_act at all: min(D_H,R_H)=0 with all declared pumps in P_U reading not-running AND every outlet's own headroom 0 already, OR the unit's own gauged level reading is already above its declared flood threshold at evaluation time -- i.e. the system is already exhausted/overtopped, checked BEFORE computing S_H/T_act since the ratio construction assumes capacity has not yet hit zero; LR ('REFUSED') := any of this proposal's or the unit-resolution step's refusal codes fired -- LR always takes precedence over every numeric band, exactly as PROP-FLOOD-02/03's REFUSED-is-a-non-value discipline requires. The verbs attached to each Thai label above (e.g. ยังมีเวลาค่อยๆทำ vs เร่งด่วนเดี๋ยวนี้) are FloodConnect application wording, not part of this proposal's declared numbers -- this object defines only the thresholds and the level identifiers L0..L5/LR.
readout_classes.binding: OUTLET vs PUMP at unit level, plus a per-outlet boolean identifying the constraining outlet when U declares more than one -- reused pattern from PROP-FLOOD-05a's HIGHER_SIDE/LOWER_SIDE per-structure readout, generalised here to per-outlet argmin rather than a two-sided comparison
readout_classes.refusal: REFUSED with reason in {UNIT_NOT_DECLARED, UNIT_POLYGON_MISSING, OUTLET_CAPACITY_UNKNOWN, NO_GAUGE_IN_UNIT, MISSING_INPUT, STALE_INPUT, UNDECLARED_AREA, UNDECLARED_EDGE, ZERO_CAPACITY_NONZERO_INFLOW} (NO_PUMPS_IN_UNIT is declared explicitly NOT a refusal code -- it is the valid D_H(U):=0 case). Precedence, checked in this fixed order: (1) UNIT_NOT_DECLARED / UNIT_POLYGON_MISSING -- the (lat,lon)-resolution step cannot produce a usable tuple at all; (2) OUTLET_CAPACITY_UNKNOWN / NO_GAUGE_IN_UNIT -- the tuple resolved but a specific resolved input lacks a value; (3) MISSING_INPUT/STALE_INPUT -- a declared input exists but its current reading is absent/stale; (4) UNDECLARED_AREA/UNDECLARED_EDGE -- reused verbatim from PROP-FLOOD-03; (5) ZERO_CAPACITY_NONZERO_INFLOW -- the degenerate ratio case, checked last since it requires every upstream value to have resolved successfully. LR (REFUSED) in the tier ladder fires whenever any of these codes fires, and always outranks every numeric L0..L5 band.

claim_boundary: This is a finite bookkeeping ratio over declared readouts and declared static constants, not a hydraulic/hydrological simulation: no channel routing, no unsteady-flow (Saint-Venant) solve, no rainfall-runoff model beyond the single declared scalar c_U (or its bound pair) is asserted. Q_cap,o is a DECLARED capacity constant (e.g. 3,000-3,100 m^3/s for the Bangkok Chao Phraya reach, tagged RELAYED -- relayed from a capacity note, not independently re-measured here) and must carry its own source tag wherever instantiated; using it without a tag is a protocol violation, not a licensed use of this object. g_U(t)'s OPEN default of 1 (no derating) is a stated assumption, not a measured pump/tide-interaction curve, and must be reported with its OPEN flag whenever no derating condition is declared. The tier boundaries (OK/TIGHT/CRITICAL) are a declared convention for human triage, not a derived flood-onset boundary; they carry no claim that CRITICAL implies flooding or that OK implies safety. The upstream-inflow term Q_in,up is only as complete as U's declared graph edges, exactly as PROP-FLOOD-03's Q_in discipline requires -- an undeclared upstream contribution is refused, never silently zeroed.

parents.evidence: Q_cap,o - Q_o,now (the per-outlet headroom margin) is a retained difference between a declared static capacity and a currently sampled reading, composed additively across outlets and multiplied by a finite horizon H*3600 -- the same root primitive (delta_R = (a sharp b), Th_coqc per readout_genesis Part I) that PROP-FLOOD-01/03/04 already cite, here applied to a capacity-vs-flow margin rather than a temporal trend or a spatial head-gradient.

PROP-FLOOD-03's finite water-balance ledger (S_b(k+1) := S_b(k) + P(k)*A_b*c_b + Q_in(k)*tau - Q_out(k)*tau, on Q, with an explicit REFUSED discipline for MISSING_INPUT/STALE_INPUT/UNDECLARED_AREA/UNDECLARED_EDGE/NEGATIVE_STORAGE) is the direct parent of this proposal's F_H(U) rainfall-runoff term (c_U*A_U*rain, PROP-FLOOD-03's P(k)*A_b*c_b term summed over H) and of its refusal-code discipline (UNDECLARED_AREA, UNDECLARED_EDGE reused verbatim; STALE_INPUT/MISSING_INPUT reused verbatim). This proposal does not re-derive the tick-by-tick ledger; it aggregates a horizon-H forecast volume from the same declared per-tick shape and adds a distinct outlet-capacity term (R_H) and pump-clearance term (D_H) that PROP-FLOOD-03 does not itself construct.

T_act(U) is a direct reuse of PROP-FLOOD-02's time-to-threshold-by-linear-extension construction (T_k := (theta-h(t))*k/Delta_k(t), defined only while rising toward theta, REFUSED otherwise), instantiated with a time-varying threshold theta:=min(D_t,R_t) and h(t):=F_t(U) in place of a single fixed theta and a single sensor series; PROP-FLOOD-02's REFUSED-as-non-value discipline is also the precedent for this proposal's own ZERO_CAPACITY_NONZERO_INFLOW refusal (when min(D_H,R_H)=0 and F_H>0, S_H(U) would be an unbounded ratio, reported as REFUSED per the workspace's zero-infinity non-readout guard, never as +infinity or a maximal CRITICAL number).

PROP-FLOOD-05a's per-structure BURDENED/RELIEVED/UNRESOLVED boolean readout over a declared side-to-zone map is the precedent for this proposal's binding(U)/binding(o) readouts: a second, declared-convention classification layered on top of the primary finite quantity, evaluated per declared object (per outlet here, per structure there) rather than only at the aggregate level.

As PROP-FLOOD-03 already established, RGD-CHEM-001's closed-boundary ledger (A(n1-n0)=0) generalises into an open-node ledger with declared in/out/created/obstructed terms; this proposal is a horizon-aggregated, multi-outlet/multi-pump instance of that same open-node shape, summed over H ticks and over a declared outlet/pump set rather than evaluated tick-by-tick at a single node.

genesis_compatibility.gate: readout_genesis Part VI-A, section B.2a 'Synthesis Bookkeeping -- Normal Forms, Lineage, Conservation, and Complexity', subsection 'A generic conservation ledger' (tier [Dr]) -- the same gate PROP-FLOOD-03 instantiates
genesis_compatibility.quote: "C(𝔖_{n+1}) − C(𝔖_n) = J_n^in − J_n^out + J_n^created − J_n^obstructed" and "This ledger is architecture, not a physics claim..." (READOUT_GENESIS_CORE.md, Part VI-A, B.2a)
genesis_compatibility.note: This proposal is a horizon-H, multi-outlet/multi-pump/multi-edge aggregation of the same generic ledger identity PROP-FLOOD-03 already mapped: J_n^in here is F_H(U) (rainfall-runoff plus declared upstream inflow, summed over H ticks); J_n^out is capped by min(D_H(U), R_H(U)) (the smaller of what pumps can actually clear and what the outlet(s) can actually convey, rather than a single node's gated Q_out); no J_n^created term is introduced. The area-generic tuple <A_U,O_U,P_U,c_U> is the declaration surface that lets the same ledger identity instantiate at village, district, provincial, and sub-basin grain without a new gate.

instantiations.O_U: Chao Phraya reach via pumping stations, discharging to the Gulf of Thailand -- one outlet, tidal
instantiations.P_U: BMA pumping stations draining into the reach
instantiations.tide_term: applies: g_U(t) derates when Gulf/river tide stage is above the declared gravity/pump threshold at the outfall
instantiations.F_H_term_used: rainfall-runoff only (c_U*A_U*rain); no material upstream-mainstem inflow term declared for this zone
instantiations.binding_note: typically PUMP-bound in heavy short-duration rain (pump capacity is the tighter constraint over short H); OUTLET-bound when the Chao Phraya itself is already near Q_cap during a joint river-flood + rain event

instantiations.unit: Sammakorn village (หมู่บ้านสัมมากร)
instantiations.O_U: Khlong Ban Ma / the village retention basin -- one outlet, non-tidal
instantiations.P_U: ST./SPS pumps declared for the village
instantiations.tide_term: does not apply: g_U(t)=1 for all t (no tidal outlet declared)
instantiations.F_H_term_used: rainfall-runoff only; no upstream-mainstem edge declared
instantiations.binding_note: PUMP-bound whenever declared pump capacity is below the canal/basin's own conveyance capacity, which is the ordinary village case

instantiations.unit: a provincial mainstem town, e.g. Ayutthaya
instantiations.O_U: the Chao Phraya mainstem itself -- one outlet, non-tidal at this reach
instantiations.P_U: declared empty -- no material pumping infrastructure at town scale -> D_H(U):=0 by definition (not refused)
instantiations.F_H_term_used: both terms, but the upstream-mainstem inflow term Q_in,up dominates: F_H(U) = c_U*A_U*rain + sum(Q_in,up(t)*3600), and for this unit the second term is the operative one
instantiations.binding_note: D_H(U)=0 collapses min(D_H,R_H) to R_H(U) -- the indicator reduces to pure river-outlet-headroom-vs-inflow, S_H(U)=F_H(U)/R_H(U), with binding(U) always OUTLET

honest_caveats: Q_cap,o for any tidal/estuarine reach (e.g. the Bangkok Chao Phraya figure of 3,000-3,100 m^3/s) is a DECLARED, RELAYED constant -- relayed from an existing capacity note, not independently re-measured by this proposal; it must carry its tag wherever instantiated, and a different declared reach requires its own sourced Q_cap,o, never a copied number.

c_U (runoff coefficient) is OPEN/INSTINCT until measured for the specific declared catchment; when undeclared, this object reports the bound pair [c=0.5, c=1], never a single silent point -- exactly the discipline PROP-FLOOD-03 already applies to its own c_b.

g_U(t)'s OPEN default of 1 (no derating) when U has not declared a gravity/pump-tide interaction is a stated assumption flagged OPEN, not a measured curve; it will understate D_H(U) at a tidal outlet whenever the real derating is <1 and unflagged.

The OK/TIGHT/CRITICAL tier boundaries (0.5, 1) are a declared triage convention, not a derived flood-onset threshold, and carry no claim that CRITICAL implies flooding will occur or OK implies it will not -- see falsifier below.

rain_t is reported as two parallel ensemble readouts (median, max), never collapsed to one number before the S_H(U) computation; which one is used for a given report must itself be a declared choice, not silently the median only.

This object composes with, but does not re-derive, PROP-FLOOD-01 (trend) or PROP-FLOOD-02 (time-to-threshold) applied to S_H(U)'s own output series across successive forecast runs -- neither is restated here.

binding(U)/binding(o) report which declared term is numerically smaller; they do not explain WHY (e.g. undersized pumps vs. an already-constrained river) -- that remains a human/domain judgment call, INSTINCT not VERIFIED.
Not yet implemented or tested against real unit data for any of the three worked instantiations; empirical_test_status is 'none'.

UNIT_NOT_DECLARED is new to this proposal (PROP-FLOOD-01..05 did not need it, being single-node/single-edge/single-structure constructions); it exists specifically so this object never silently assumes a Bangkok-shaped tuple (tidal outlet + pumps) for a unit that has neither.

The tier-ladder thresholds (S_H bands 0.3/0.6/0.9/1.2 and T_act bands 6h/24h/48h) are explicitly marked OPEN-for-founder-tuning in this registration: they are a proposed declared convention, not a value derived from data or calibrated against any observed flood event; they must not be presented as settled without a founder decision, and any founder revision bumps this object's own .v<k>, not a silent edit.

L5 ('เกินระบบแล้ว') is checked BEFORE the S_H/T_act ratio bands, not as their extreme -- it is a separate declared condition (capacity already exhausted or level already above threshold) precisely because the ratio construction presumes some capacity remains; conflating L5 with 'S_H very large' would misstate what is being reported.

The unit-resolution step (lat,lon -> U) introduces its own evidence-tag discipline (VERIFIED/RELAYED/INSTINCT) per resolved input; a resolved input with none of these three tags is treated as missing, not as a fourth silent tier -- this is additive to, not a replacement for, PROP-FLOOD-03's existing MISSING_INPUT/STALE_INPUT discipline.

The radius-r INSTINCT fallback for A_U (used only when no basin polygon is declared) is a placeholder construction, not a hydrologically meaningful catchment boundary; r itself has no default value in this proposal and must be stated explicitly by whatever caller opts into the fallback.
falsifier: Across repeated independent instantiations of this object for real declared units, a systematic mismatch between the declared tier and the observed outcome -- e.g. S_H(U) in the OK tier (<0.5) at multiple units that in fact flooded during the forecast horizon, or S_H(U) in the CRITICAL tier (>1) at multiple units that did not flood -- would falsify the tier convention's practical calibration (not the underlying arithmetic, which is definitionally true given its inputs). Separately, any observed conveyed flow at a declared outlet o exceeding its declared Q_cap,o would falsify that constant's DECLARED/RELAYED value and require re-tagging it, not silently raising it.
